flags.message: Decisive forward signal from companion dockets: the federal respondents' brief (Aug. 28, 2026) and the Authority's response ask the Court to grant Nos. 26-199 and 26-201 (FTC and Authority petitions from the Fifth Circuit's June 11, 2026 decision) and HOLD this petition; petitioners' reply asks for grant and consolidation. The Sept. 21 'Rescheduled' entry aligns this petition with that cluster (cross-petitions 26-332/26-335 have responses due Oct. 13-14). The forecast weights a hold-then-GVR path heavily; a hold means this event may stay open until mid-2027.

documents.json lists only the petition and QP; the two Aug. 28 responses (federal respondents, Authority) and the Sept. 15 reply were on the docket with supremecourt.gov links but were not provisioned. Retrieved them manually (forward mode).
